scope: All checked-in V7 userland source components; kernel sources are prerequisites, not userland inventory entries. Missing distribution commands/data, including man and usr/man, are recorded as external requirements; source-file coverage does not establish complete V7 distribution coverage.
coverage: Each checked-in file below reference_root is explicitly owned by at least one entry; overlapping ownership is permitted for shared sources.
dependency_policy: Confirmed edges have local evidence; inferred edges and unresolved audits are explicit. Cycles are allowed for toolchain bootstrap and runtime generators. This is not a completed symbol-level compatibility audit.
timestamp_policy: Preserve V7 atime/mtime/ctime semantics and on-disk widths; no birth-time field or higher precision.

requirements.description: Host GCC/binutils bootstrap native Nexix ELF builds; retained native tools remain unported.
Nexix has selected libc/kernel headers; the reference snapshot has no usr/include. Complete historical declarations and native ABI adaptation are required.
File/process/TTY syscalls exist; mount administration, accounting, tracing, profiling and complete device interfaces need auditing.
Native user FP state isolation and full floating-point libc support are not implemented.
Clock advances from epoch zero; RTC initialization and ordinary inode timestamp updates are pending steps 22–23.
UTC-only ctime currently; configurable TZ and local-time/DST conversion are step 24.
Root passwd file exists; group database, password management and authenticated login remain pending.
Current UART and line discipline provide one shared COM1 console; independent COM2 and login terminals are pending.
Empty utmp/wtmp files are packaged; complete login/process accounting is pending.
Historical kernel-memory/symbol consumers need a native information interface.
Native ptrace/profiling and executable register/symbol interpretation require implementation.
IDE block operations exist internally; raw device files and mount-management interfaces are pending.
PDP-11 disks/tapes, plotters and printer protocols require native equivalents or individually documented exceptions.
Retarget retained compiler/assembler/linker and archive/symbol utilities to native x86_64 ELF.
Provision mail/job/UUCP spool directories, ownership, locking and daemon configuration.
The parser skeleton used by yacc is absent from this snapshot.
C/Ratfor/EBCDIC scanner skeletons are absent from this snapshot.
Lint library description files referenced by the driver/makefile are absent.
Supply the word dictionary used by look, spell and hangman.
American/British/local word additions and stop list are supplied in the reference spell directory.

Supply refer bibliography/index data and common-word exclusion list.

Optional bc mathematical library is referenced but absent.
Fortune database is absent.
Quiz index and question databases are absent.
libplot backends contain source in historical .c.a archives; bootstrap extraction must support the historical archive format.
